Verify allocation identity, pinned Python path/hash, declared candidate/helper hashes and private-copy identities before any candidate/helper import. A missing, stale or mismatched binding fails closed. Lead prepares the final binding after the core API is final.
future_cli.real_wall_limit: Require positive bounded suite and per-case real-wall limits from the allocation-bound inputs before candidate import. Use original monotonic cutoff; no reset by fake time, blocked I/O or later cases. Exact values await the final allocation binding.
future_cli.case_paths: Fresh suite root and exclusive result; each Q01-Q14 case gets distinct fresh work and result paths. Existing paths are refused, not reused.
future_cli.native_actions: No native ps, site build or real validator. Synthetic child/thread use requires allocation and is allowed only where the actual routine cannot otherwise be controlled. No generic process framework or Q15/Q16 dispatch.
